description: For many Americans, driving is not a luxury—it is a daily necessity. Millions of people rely on their vehicles to get to work, school, appointments, and social activities. Yet despite advances in vehicle safety and road design, many drivers share a common frustration: the driving experience often feels less attentive, less predictable, and more stressful

title: Improving the American Driving Experience: Education, Awareness, and Better Habits on the Road - The Official Website for Zul Mirza Mohamed for Senate
